summary: Citadel has 13 years in the Qatar market, bilingual pages and active listings. The site looks dated and does not capture the leads it attracts, and a visible server error damages trust at the first glance.

findings.problem: A PHP warning is visible at the top of the page, exposing a server file path and a Permission denied error from an image plugin.
findings.cost: A visible server error tells a buyer or landlord that the site, and maybe the business, is not looked after.
findings.fix: A clean rebuild with no exposed errors, tested on every device.

findings.problem: There is no enquiry form, only a property search and a newsletter box. The page says WhatsApp us but shows no number or link.
findings.cost: A buyer ready to ask about a listing has no way to do it and moves on to the next agency.
findings.fix: An enquiry form and a working WhatsApp button on every listing.

findings.problem: Almost every listing says Price on request, Find Your Home and the main menu links go to #, and the footer still reads Citadel 2019.
findings.cost: Hidden prices and dead links remove the reasons to click, and a 2019 footer signals an agency that has stopped updating.
findings.fix: Clear prices where possible, working navigation and a current, trustworthy look.

findings.problem: The linkedin icon points to Snapchat, two different phone numbers are shown, and the same listings appear twice. Typos such as suite to the property appear in the copy.
findings.cost: Mismatched contact details and typos make buyers unsure which number is real and who to trust with a large purchase.
findings.fix: One verified contact set, correct social links and proofread copy.

redesign: A lead first homepage: property search, enquiry form and WhatsApp on every listing.
Proof near every enquiry button: named agents, licence details and client reviews.
Area pages written to rank for searches like apartments for rent in Doha and villas for sale in Qatar.
